question: P is thrice as good as workman as Q and therefore is able to finish a work in 40 days less than Q. In how many days can they together complete the same work?
solution:
Given: 

P is thrice as good as a workman as Q 

He is able to finish work in 40 days less than Q

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of Q is x,

So the efficiency of P is 3x

So P takes x days then Q takes 3x days.

As per the question,

⇒ 3x - x = 40

⇒ 2x = 40

⇒ x = 20

So P takes 20 days then Q takes 3 × 20 = 60 days.

Let the total work is the 60 units (LCM of 20 and 60)

they together complete the same work in

⇒ 60 / (3+1)

⇒ 60 / 4

= 15 days

**∴ The correct option is 3** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] __Additional Information__Efficiency of a person is inversely proportional to number of days to complete the work.
